SELECT /* kh.com.kbprasac.csu.lne.cmn.dao.MsgMgtDao.selectListMsgMgt */ LANG_DSTCD AS "langDstcd" /* 언어구분코드 */ , ERR_MSGCD AS "errMsgcd" /* 에러메시지코드 */ , CHNL_DSTCD AS "chnlDstcd" /* 채널구분코드 */ , OUTPT_CTNT1 AS "outptCtnt1" /* 출력내용1 */ , OUTPT_CTNT2 AS "outptCtnt2" /* 출력내용2 */ , MSG_KND_CD_NO AS "msgKndCdNo" /* 메시지종류코드번호 */ , count(0)over() AS "totalCnt" FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0003 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd}
AND LANG_DSTCD = #{langDstcd}
AND ERR_MSGCD LIKE '%' || #{errMsgcd} || '%'
AND UPPER(OUTPT_CTNT1) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{outptCtnt1}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ERR_MSGCD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{bzwkDstcd}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ERR_MSGCD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{msgKndCdNo}) || '%'
ORDER BY ERR_MSGCD, LANG_DSTCD OFFSET (#{pageCnt}*(#{pageNo}-1)) ROWS FETCH FIRST #{pageCnt} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* kh.com.kbprasac.csu.lne.cmn.dao.MsgMgtDao.selectMsgcdExstYn */ CASE WHEN MAX(ERR_MSGCD) IS NULL THEN #{bzwkDstcd} || #{msgKndCdNo} || '00001' ELSE #{bzwkDstcd} || #{msgKndCdNo} || LPAD(TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(ERR_MSGCD), 5)) + 1), 5, '0') END AS "errMsgcd" FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0003 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND ERR_MSGCD LIKE #{bzwkDstcd} || #{msgKndCdNo} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT /* kh.com.kbprasac.csu.lne.cmn.dao.MsgMgtDao.insertMsgMgt */ INTO ${schema}.TSCSM0003 ( OPER_GROUP_CD , LANG_DSTCD , ERR_MSGCD , CHNL_DSTCD , OUTPT_CTNT1 , OUTPT_CTNT2 , MSG_KND_CD_NO , SYS_LAST_PRCSS_YMS , SYS_LAST_UNO ) VALUES ( #{operGroupCd} , #{langDstcd} , #{errMsgcd} , #{chnlDstcd} , #{outptCtnt1} , NVL(#{outptCtnt2}, ' ') , #{msgKndCdNo} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{sysLastUno} )
